description: Defines classes, structs, and functions related to game status, time of day, player info, and game state management for the Wesnoth game.

classes.name: gamestatus
classes.description: Manages the current turn, time of day, and related game state information.

classes.name: player_info
classes.description: Holds data about a player's gold, available units, and recruit options.

classes.name: game_state
classes.description: Represents the entire game state, including scenario, players, variables, and save/load functions.

methods.name: gamestatus::write
methods.description: Serializes the game status to a config object.

methods.name: gamestatus::next_turn
methods.description: Advances the game to the next turn, returning true if time has expired.

methods.name: game_state::get_player
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the player_info for a given ID.
